cards.en: Put the blue block in the box
Touch your head, then your knees
Put the teddy on the chair
Take one step to the left
Take two steps to the right
Put the teddy under the table
Put three blocks in a row
Find something red and bring it here
Touch your shoulders, knees and toes
Fly like a bird, then freeze
Turn around, then clap three times
Put your hands on your hips
